functino to assign spatial foci using single-linkage clustering // also identifies isolated spots
```{r}
assign_spatial_foci <- function(spots, link_distance_px) {
  focus_input <- spots %>%
    distinct(spbc, image_x, image_y)

  focus_input$focus_cluster <- cutree(
    hclust(dist(focus_input %>% select(image_x, image_y)), method = "single"),
    h = link_distance_px)

  focus_labels <- focus_input %>%
    group_by(focus_cluster) %>%
    summarise(n_spots = n(), center_x = mean(image_x), center_y = mean(image_y), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(is_isolated = n_spots == 1) %>%
    arrange(is_isolated, desc(n_spots), center_y, center_x, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(focus_number = row_number(),
           focus_id = if_else(is_isolated, "Isolated", paste("Niche", focus_number))) %>%
    ungroup()

  focus_input %>%
    left_join(focus_labels %>% select(focus_cluster, focus_id, is_isolated),
      by = "focus_cluster")
}
```

define the selected AF clone and its noAF status
```{r}
#read in
af_raw <- readr::read_tsv(AF_AIRR_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
noaf_raw <- readr::read_tsv(NOAF_AIRR_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)

# filter for IGH, apply downstream filters 
af_igh <- af_raw %>%
  select(-any_of(c("x", "y"))) %>%
  mutate(group = as.character(group),
        spbc = as.character(spbc),
        umi = as.character(umi),
        sequence_id = paste("AF", sequence_id, sep = "|"),
        v_region_sequence = str_sub(toupper(sequence),
        start = as.integer(v_sequence_start), end = as.integer(v_sequence_end)),
        c_call_subfam = str_remove(c_call, "\\*.*$"),
        junction_aa = coalesce(na_if(as.character(junction_aa), ""), as.character(alakazam::translateDNA(as.character(junction))))) %>%
  filter(locus == "IGH",
         !is.na(group), group != "",
         !is.na(c_call), str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus,
         !str_detect(umi, "TTTTTTTTTTT"),
         !is.na(junction), junction != "", !str_detect(junction, "N"),
         !is.na(v_region_sequence), !str_detect(v_region_sequence, "N"),
         #c_call_subfam %in% c("IGHA1", "IGHA2", "IGHG1", "IGHG2", "IGHG3", "IGHG4", "IGHM"),
         consensus_count >= CLONE_DEFINITION_MIN_CONSENSUS_COUNT) %>%
  # filter(str_detect(toupper(fwr1), "^[ACGT]"),
  # if_all(c(fwr1, cdr1, fwr2, cdr2, fwr3, cdr3, fwr4),
  #        ~ str_detect(toupper(.x), "[ACGT]"))) %>%
  arrange(v_call, j_call, junction_length, junction, group)

# lookup which groups are found in noAF dataset
noaf_lookup <- noaf_raw %>%
  filter(locus == "IGH") %>%
  transmute(group = as.character(group),
            noaf_present = TRUE,
            noaf_productive = as.logical(productive)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group), group != "") %>%
  distinct(group, .keep_all = TRUE)

#assign clones // only keep sequences in clone that are AF-eligble and put reads into //
af_distances <- shazam::distToNearest(af_igh, model = "ham", normalize = "len", vCallColumn = "v_call", locusValues = "IGH", nproc = NPROC)
af_clones <- scoper::hierarchicalClones(af_distances, method = "nt", first = FALSE, threshold = CLONE_THRESHOLD, verbose = FALSE, nproc = NPROC) %>%
  mutate(clone_id_af = as.character(clone_id), af_applied = !is.na(n_orig) & n_orig >= AF_APPLIED_MIN_N_ORIG) %>%
  left_join(noaf_lookup, by = "group") %>%
  mutate(noaf_status = case_when(
         !af_applied ~ "AF not applied",
         is.na(noaf_present) ~ "Not recovered in no-AF AIRR output",
         noaf_productive %in% TRUE ~ "Productive without AF",
         noaf_productive %in% FALSE ~ "Nonproductive without AF",
         TRUE ~ "Productivity unavailable without AF"))
```

read tissue image and spatial coordinates
```{r}
#read in HE image
tissue_image <- tiff::readTIFF(ORIGINAL_TISSUE_IMAGE_PATH)
image_height <- dim(tissue_image)[1]
image_width <- dim(tissue_image)[2]

tissue_positions <- readr::read_csv(TISSUE_POSITIONS_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(spbc = str_remove(as.character(barcode), "-1$"),
         image_x = pxl_col_in_fullres,
         image_y = pxl_row_in_fullres)

tissue_background <- annotation_raster(tissue_image, xmin = 0, xmax = image_width, ymin = image_height, ymax = 0)

# fixed positions for scale bars
# Convert registered-image pixels to physical distance using adjacent
# standard Visium spot centers, which are 100 micrometers apart.
visium_neighbor_distances <- tissue_positions %>%
  arrange(array_row, array_col) %>%
  group_by(array_row) %>%
  mutate(next_array_col = lead(array_col),
         next_image_x = lead(image_x),
         next_image_y = lead(image_y),
         neighbor_distance_px = sqrt((next_image_x - image_x)^2 + (next_image_y - image_y)^2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(next_array_col - array_col == 2)

pixels_per_um <- median(visium_neighbor_distances$neighbor_distance_px, na.rm = TRUE) / VISIUM_NEIGHBOR_DISTANCE_UM # VISIUM_NEIGHBOUR_DISTANCE_UM = 100
spot_diameter <- VISIUM_SPOT_DIAMETER_UM * pixels_per_um

```

```{r}
# scale bars
make_scale_bar <- function(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, length_um) {
  x_range <- xmax - xmin
  y_range <- ymax - ymin
  x_start <- xmin + 0.07 * x_range
  x_end <- x_start + length_um * pixels_per_um
  y_bar <- ymax - 0.10 * y_range
  tick_height <- 0.025 * y_range
  scale_label <- if_else(length_um == 1000, "1 mm", paste0(length_um, " µm"))

  list(annotate("segment", x = x_start, xend = x_end, y = y_bar, yend = y_bar,
       linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
       annotate("segment", x = x_start, xend = x_start,
       y = y_bar - tick_height, yend = y_bar + tick_height,
       linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
       annotate("segment", x = x_end, xend = x_end,
       y = y_bar - tick_height, yend = y_bar + tick_height,
       linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
       annotate("text", x = (x_start + x_end) / 2, y = y_bar + 0.055 * y_range,
       label = scale_label, size = 2.2, color = "black"))
}
```

prepare selected clone and spatial foci
```{r}
#prep for spatial clone distribution where spatially distinct locations are colored differently
# and also prep for corresponding lineage

detail_clone_lineage <- af_clones %>%
  filter(clone_id_af == as.character(DETAIL_CLONE), spbc %in% tissue_positions$spbc,
         consensus_count >= LINEAGE_MIN_CONSENSUS_COUNT,
         n_orig >= LINEAGE_MIN_N_ORIG) %>%
  mutate(clone_id = clone_id_af,
         c_call_subfam = as.character(c_call_subfam),
         spbc = as.character(spbc),
         junction = as.character(junction),
         junction_aa = as.character(junction_aa),
         node_noaf_productive = as.integer(noaf_status == "Productive without AF"),
         node_noaf_nonproductive = as.integer(noaf_status == "Nonproductive without AF"),
         node_noaf_not_recovered = as.integer(noaf_status == "Not recovered in no-AF AIRR output"),
         node_noaf_productivity_unavailable = as.integer(noaf_status == "Productivity unavailable without AF"),
         node_af_not_applied = as.integer(noaf_status == "AF not applied"))


detail_clone_lineage_full <- detail_clone_lineage %>%
  filter(str_detect(toupper(fwr1), "^[ACGT]"),
  if_all(c(fwr1, cdr1, fwr2, cdr2, fwr3, cdr3, fwr4),
         ~ str_detect(toupper(.x), "[ACGT]")))

detail_clone_lineage <- detail_clone_lineage_full

focus_map <- detail_clone_lineage %>%
  distinct(spbc) %>%
  inner_join(tissue_positions %>% filter(in_tissue == 1) %>% 
  select(spbc, image_x, image_y), by = "spbc") %>%
  assign_spatial_foci(link_distance_px = FOCUS_LINK_DISTANCE_UM * pixels_per_um)

detail_clone_lineage <- detail_clone_lineage %>%
  left_join(focus_map %>% select(spbc, focus_id), by = "spbc")

focus_ids <- focus_map %>%
             filter(!is_isolated) %>%
             distinct(focus_id) %>%
             pull(focus_id) %>%
             sort()

focus_palette <- c(setNames(rep(FOCUS_COLORS, length.out = length(focus_ids)), focus_ids),"Isolated" = ISOLATED_COLOR)

#integrate focus map with palette for distinct colors and shapes
detail_spatial_df <- focus_map %>%
  mutate(focus_id = factor(focus_id, levels = names(focus_palette)),
         spatial_shape = if_else(is_isolated, "Isolated", "Niche"))

#which group / focus / spots are used for the zoom in
zoom_spots <- detail_spatial_df %>%
  filter(focus_id == ZOOM_FOCUS) %>%
  arrange(image_y, image_x) %>%
  mutate(spot_number = row_number(),
         spot_marker = if_else(spot_number %in% HIGHLIGHT_SPOT_NUMBERS,
                       paste("Spot", spot_number),"Other niche spots"))

marker_levels <- c("Other niche spots", paste("Spot", HIGHLIGHT_SPOT_NUMBERS))

#zoom spots
zoom_spots <- zoom_spots %>%
  mutate(spot_marker = factor(spot_marker, levels = marker_levels))

#integrate zoom spots with distinct shapes
spot_shape_palette <- setNames(c(21, HIGHLIGHT_SPOT_SHAPES), marker_levels)
```

construct noAF-AF lineage
```{r}
# Track highlighted-spot membership as counts; these do not split collapsed sequences.
highlight_count_fields <- paste0("selected_spot_count_", HIGHLIGHT_SPOT_NUMBERS)
highlight_marker_lookup <- tibble(marker_field = highlight_count_fields,
                                  spot_marker = paste("Spot", HIGHLIGHT_SPOT_NUMBERS),
                                  marker_order = seq_along(HIGHLIGHT_SPOT_NUMBERS))

for (i in seq_along(HIGHLIGHT_SPOT_NUMBERS)) {
  selected_barcodes <- zoom_spots$spbc[zoom_spots$spot_number == HIGHLIGHT_SPOT_NUMBERS[i]]
  detail_clone_lineage[[highlight_count_fields[i]]] <- as.integer(detail_clone_lineage$spbc %in% selected_barcodes)
}

references <- dowser::readIMGT(dir = IMGT_GERMLINE_DIR)
detail_tree_input <- dowser::createGermlines(detail_clone_lineage, references, nproc = NPROC)
# keep isotype and focus id unique (collapse all other attributes based on identical sequence)
detail_formatted <- dowser::formatClones(detail_tree_input,
  traits = c("c_call_subfam", "focus_id"),
  num_fields = c("node_noaf_productive", "node_noaf_nonproductive",
                 "node_noaf_not_recovered", "node_noaf_productivity_unavailable", "node_af_not_applied",
                 highlight_count_fields),
  minseq = 2, nproc = NPROC, collapse = TRUE, filterstop = FALSE)

#build lineage tree
detail_trees <- dowser::getTrees(detail_formatted, nproc = NPROC) %>%
                dowser::scaleBranches(edge_type = "mutations")

phylo_tree <- detail_trees$trees[[1]]

#metadata for colours and labels // here subcategories available, will be further collapsed
# links each AF seq to noAF categories
node_metadata <- methods::slot(detail_trees$data[[1]], "data") %>%
  transmute(
    label = as.character(sequence_id),
    focus_id = as.character(focus_id),
    collapse_count = as.numeric(collapse_count),
    across(all_of(highlight_count_fields), ~replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0)),
    node_noaf_productive = as.numeric(node_noaf_productive),
    node_noaf_nonproductive = as.numeric(node_noaf_nonproductive),
    node_noaf_not_recovered = as.numeric(node_noaf_not_recovered),
    node_noaf_productivity_unavailable = as.numeric(node_noaf_productivity_unavailable),
    node_af_not_applied = as.numeric(node_af_not_applied)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(collapse_count, starts_with("node_")), ~replace_na(.x, 0)),
         node_af_evaluable_count = node_noaf_productive + node_noaf_nonproductive + node_noaf_not_recovered, 
         node_af_dependent_count = node_noaf_nonproductive + node_noaf_not_recovered) 

#numbers for lineage subtitle
tree_summary <- node_metadata %>%
  summarise(n_af_evaluable = sum(node_af_evaluable_count), # number of all groups eligble to be processed by AF
            n_af_dependent = sum(node_af_dependent_count)) %>%  # number of AF groups that are nonprod or not observed in noAF
  mutate(pct_af_dependent = 100 * n_af_dependent / n_af_evaluable)
```

full-tissue spatial figure
```{r}
tissue_x_limits <- c(image_width * TISSUE_CROP_LEFT, image_width * TISSUE_CROP_RIGHT)
tissue_y_limits <- c(image_height * TISSUE_CROP_BOTTOM, image_height * TISSUE_CROP_TOP)

zoom_padding <- ZOOM_PADDING_SPOTS * spot_diameter
zoom_x_limits <- c(max(0, min(zoom_spots$image_x) - zoom_padding),
                   min(image_width, max(zoom_spots$image_x) + ZOOM_RIGHT_PADDING_SPOTS * spot_diameter))
zoom_y_limits <- c(min(image_height, max(zoom_spots$image_y) + zoom_padding),
                   max(0, min(zoom_spots$image_y) - zoom_padding))

p_detail_spatial <- ggplot() + tissue_background +
  annotate("rect", xmin = zoom_x_limits[1], xmax = zoom_x_limits[2],
           ymin = zoom_y_limits[2], ymax = zoom_y_limits[1], fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = detail_spatial_df, aes(x = image_x, y = image_y, fill = focus_id, shape = spatial_shape),
             size = SPATIAL_POINT_SIZE, stroke = 0.25, color="black") +
  make_scale_bar(tissue_x_limits[1], tissue_x_limits[2],
                 tissue_y_limits[2], tissue_y_limits[1], TISSUE_SCALE_BAR_UM) +
  scale_color_manual(values = focus_palette, name = "Spatial niches", drop = TRUE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Niche" = 21, "Isolated" = 4), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(image_height, 0), expand = expansion(0)) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = tissue_x_limits, ylim = tissue_y_limits, expand = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = focus_palette, name = "Spatial niches", drop = TRUE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Niche" = 21, "Isolated" = 4), guide = "none") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE,
                             override.aes = list(shape = c(rep(21, length(focus_ids)), 4), color = "black", size = 2.4, stroke = 0.4))) +
  theme_void(base_size = 7) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(1, "pt"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
```

6 D - lineage tree

lineage figure
```{r}
detail_tree <- ggtree::ggtree(phylo_tree)

detail_tree_data <- detail_tree$data %>%
  mutate(label = as.character(label)) %>%
  left_join(node_metadata, by = "label") %>%
  mutate(is_germline = label == "Germline",
         is_observed = label %in% node_metadata$label,
         collapse_count = if_else(is_germline, 1, replace_na(collapse_count, 1)),
         node_af_impact = case_when(is_germline ~ "Germline",
                                    is_observed & node_af_dependent_count > 0 ~ "AF-recovered groups",
                                    is_observed & node_af_evaluable_count > 0 ~ "AF-independent groups",
                                    is_observed ~ "N_ORIG < 5",
                                    TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         node_count_label = case_when(
         !is_observed | collapse_count <= 1 ~ NA_character_,
         node_af_evaluable_count == 0 ~ as.character(collapse_count),
         node_af_evaluable_count == collapse_count & node_af_dependent_count > 0 ~ paste0(node_af_dependent_count, "/", collapse_count),
         node_af_evaluable_count == collapse_count ~ as.character(collapse_count),
         TRUE ~ paste0(node_af_dependent_count, "/", node_af_evaluable_count, "/", collapse_count)))

detail_tree$data <- detail_tree_data

# group labels
lineage_focus <- detail_tree_data %>%
  filter(is_observed) %>%
  mutate(focus_color = unname(focus_palette[as.character(focus_id)]),
         focus_x = x + TREE_FOCUS_OFFSET * 0.7,
         focus_label = recode(as.character(focus_id), "1" = "Niche 1", "2" = "Niche 2", "3" = "Niche 3", "4" = "Niche 4")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(focus_color))

lineage_labels <- detail_tree_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(node_count_label)) %>%
  mutate(label_x = x + AF_LABEL_OFFSET)

af_node_palette <- c("AF-recovered groups" = "#D95F02", "AF-independent groups" = "gray35", "N_ORIG < 5" = "#BDBDBD", "Germline" = "black")

# A collapsed node can contain sequences from several highlighted spots.
# Show each represented spot once, using the same shapes as the zoom and UCell panel.
lineage_spot_symbols <- lineage_focus %>%
  select(label, y, focus_x, all_of(highlight_count_fields)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(highlight_count_fields), names_to = "marker_field", values_to = "spot_group_count") %>%
  filter(spot_group_count > 0) %>%
  left_join(highlight_marker_lookup, by = "marker_field") %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  arrange(marker_order, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(marker_x = focus_x + TREE_SPOT_OFFSET + (row_number() - 1) * TREE_SPOT_SPACING) %>%
  ungroup()

lineage_xmax <- max(detail_tree_data$x, lineage_focus$focus_x, lineage_labels$label_x,
                    lineage_spot_symbols$marker_x, na.rm = TRUE)

grid_data <- tibble(x = seq(TREE_GRID_STEP, floor(max(detail_tree_data$x, na.rm = TRUE) / TREE_GRID_STEP) * TREE_GRID_STEP, by = TREE_GRID_STEP), y = 0) %>%
  mutate(label = as.character(x))

```


```{r}
p_detail_lineage <- detail_tree +
  geom_vline(data = grid_data, aes(xintercept = x), inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey70") +
  geom_text(data = grid_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5, vjust = 1.25, color = "grey35") +
  geom_point(data = detail_tree_data %>% filter(is_observed | is_germline),
             aes(x = x, y = y, color = node_af_impact, size = collapse_count), inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 16) +
  geom_text(data = lineage_labels, aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = node_count_label, color = node_af_impact),
  inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 1.5, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = lineage_focus, aes(x = focus_x, y = y, label = focus_label, fill = focus_color),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 1.5,color = ifelse(lineage_focus$focus_label %in% c("Niche 2", "Niche 3"),"black", "white"),
             fontface = "bold", label.padding = grid::unit(0.15, "lines"), label.r = grid::unit(0, "lines"), linewidth = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = lineage_spot_symbols, aes(x = marker_x, y = y, shape = spot_marker),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = TREE_SPOT_SIZE, stroke = 0.4,
             color = "black", fill = "white", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = spot_shape_palette, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = af_node_palette, breaks = names(af_node_palette), 
                     labels = c("AF-recovered", "AF-independent", "N_ORIG < 5", "Germline"), drop = TRUE) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.8, 4.2), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE, title="Adaptive filter\n   specificity")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, lineage_xmax + 8), clip = "off") +
  ggtree::theme_tree(base_size=7) +
  labs(subtitle = paste0(tree_summary$n_af_dependent, "/", tree_summary$n_af_evaluable,
                  " groups (N_ORIG > 4) are recovered by adaptive filtering (",
                  scales::number(tree_summary$pct_af_dependent, accuracy = 0.1), "%)")) +
  theme(text = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black", margin = margin(b = 3)),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.margin = margin(r=-42, 2, 2, 2)
  )
```

---------------
6 F - Ucell, zoom-in
--------------

cell-signature enrichment in the largest focus
```{r}
#read-in ucell scores
ucell_long <- readRDS(UCELL_RDS_PATH) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(spbc = str_remove(as.character(spbc_clean), "-1$")) %>%
  inner_join(tissue_positions %>% filter(in_tissue == 1) %>% select(spbc), by = "spbc") %>%
  select(spbc, all_of(unname(UCELL_SIGNATURES))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -spbc, names_to = "signature_column", values_to = "ucell_score") %>%
  group_by(signature_column) %>%
  mutate(ucell_z = as.numeric(scale(ucell_score))) %>% #re-scale ucell scores for this example
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(signature = names(UCELL_SIGNATURES)[match(signature_column, unname(UCELL_SIGNATURES))],
         signature = factor(signature, levels = rev(names(UCELL_SIGNATURES))))

clone_ucell <- ucell_long %>%
  inner_join(zoom_spots %>% select(spbc, spot_number, spot_marker, focus_id), by = "spbc")

clone_ucell_summary <- clone_ucell %>%
  group_by(signature) %>%
  summarise(mean_ucell_z = mean(ucell_z, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

```

```{r}
p_clone_ucell <- ggplot(clone_ucell_summary, aes(x = mean_ucell_z, y = signature)) +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey80", color = "gray35", linewidth = 0.25, width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  #geom_col(fill = "grey80", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.68) +
  geom_point(data = clone_ucell,
    aes(x = ucell_z, y = signature, color = focus_id, shape = spot_marker),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5, fill = NA, stroke = 0.5,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.10, seed = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = focus_palette, guide = "none") +

  guides(shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE,
    override.aes = list(size = 2, color = "black"))) +
  labs(x = "Normalized expression-signature score\n(UCell z-score)",
    y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),

    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),

    legend.position = "bottom",
```
